name: backslash-graph-api
description: Graph query API over microservice dependency graph

scripts.verify:build: npm run build && PORT=3001 node -e "require('./dist/server'); const http=require('http'); setTimeout(()=>http.get('http://localhost:3001/api/routes',r=>{let d='';r.on('data',c=>d+=c);r.on('end',()=>{console.log('Build OK',JSON.parse(d).nodes.length,'nodes');process.exit(0);})}).on('error',e=>{console.error(e.message);process.exit(1);}),500);"
